name: Central neuron
failures: Neurodegeneration, stroke infarction, trauma. Glial scar blocks regrowth; no meaningful replacement.

see.note: Imaging and CSF markers are indirect. No single-cell state in a living brain.

model.note: The substrate is identity — a healthy target state cannot be specified without specifying the person.

reach.note: Intrathecal delivery reaches spinal cord; nothing reaches brain broadly. See the CNS delivery module.

edit.note: Nusinersen treats a spinal motor-neuron disease. No neuron has been replaced in a human.

verify.note: Clinical scores and biomarkers; no direct confirmation of cell-level change.
